en: A vintage black-and-white postcard image showing a central town square surrounded by ornate buildings with distinctly European architecture. There is a small monument or fountain in the foreground, horse-drawn carriages, and a few people walking around. One building has a dome with a weather vane. The text at the top of the image reads 'Naumburg a. Saale. Kaiser Wilhelmplatz.'
